title: engagement analysis loads its filtered data twice after the first load

criteria.given: the page has completed its first load
criteria.then: each filtered endpoint received exactly one data request and the loaded results are on display

criteria.given: one analysis filter changes after the first load
criteria.then: each filtered endpoint receives exactly one further data request

criteria.given: an older response for an earlier filter lands after a newer one
criteria.then: the newer results stay on display and the stale response is never applied
